data.name: Birjesh
data.gender_notes: Birjesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit words 'Bir' meaning 'Lord' and 'Jesh' meaning 'of Vishnu'. This name is considered to honor and invoke the protection of Vishnu. The name Birjesh carries the meaning “Lord of Vishnu” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Birjesh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of vishnu and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Name of a devotee of Vishnu
data.etymology: Birjesh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Vishnu.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Birjesh total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
